assumptions: Finite positive segment length and fixed captured branch.
Lambda_f>=0, Lambda>=0, nonnegative frozen P_f for the saved B_r construction.
Integrable coefficient defects and bounded E/heat weights on the finite segment.
Initial uncertainty |e|<=eta is carried; quadrature and representation errors are not silently removed.

finite_second_correction_identity.derivation: delta1=(I+K)delta-F e; delta-(I-K)delta1=delta-(I-K)(I+K)delta+(I-K)F e=K^2 delta+(I-K)F e. No infinite-series convergence assumption is used.

limitations: No enclosed prefix delta1(v) or signed K delta1 integral has been computed.
Existing endpoint sums cannot reconstruct all prefixes or justify multiplying the old full interval width by D.
The displayed formal TDS/TS factors exclude propagated incoming uncertainty, midpoint quadrature, representation and centering.
No cost, whole-width improvement factor, O(N) implementation or new heavy allocation is established.

checks: eta term remains on later segments
DeltaLambda=0 kills photon K but need not kill separate species DeltaLambda_i moment correction
D=0 and all species variations=0 remove coupling corrections
t is the dimensionless log-scale-factor displacement, so D is dimensionless
T_i carries the weight units; H_h D S has photon-stock units
Z has no direct DeltaLambda_i term; QN/QE have no photon-coupling remainder
selected heat triangle bounds retain inherited active heat-weight positivity and fixed captured branch assumptions

species_moment_identity.derivation: Expand lambda_i(P_f+delta); substitute delta-delta1=F e-K delta in the lambda_fi term. Absolute integrability on the finite segment permits Fubini: -integral w lambda_fi K delta=-integral Q_i DeltaLambda delta, producing k_i=w DeltaLambda_i-Q_i DeltaLambda and the separate G_i e term.

species_second_correction_bound.derivation: After adding integral k_i delta1 the residual is G_i e+integral k_i(F e-K delta); |F|<=1, integral|k_i|<=T_i and ||K delta||<=D*S give (|G_i|+T_i)*eta+T_i*D*S.

true_defect_sup_bound.derivation: delta'=r-Lambda*delta, Lambda>=0 imply |delta(t)|<=|c|+eta+integral|r|<=S. This avoids an unnecessary 1/(1-D) factor and does not require D<1.

uniform_and_terminal_bounds.qualification: Bounds concern the exact second-correction function; integration, representation and centering radii must be added by a future implementation.

variation_of_constants.statement: delta=delta1+F*e-K*delta follows from delta'=r-Lambda_f*delta-DeltaLambda*delta and delta(0)=c+e.

whole_operator_norm.derivation: 0<F<=1 gives ||K z||inf<=D||z||inf with D>=integral|DeltaLambda|. Saved D_L integrates a whole-cell interval upper bound. Endpoint-only H_h is not substituted for this uniform operator norm.
